components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared pill action with the workbench primary gradient; mail and confirmation use the solid blue variant.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Quiet glass action with a brighter hover surface and visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Destructive confirmation action
components.description: Filled danger action for the existing destructive confirmation option.
components.css: .ds-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:var(--font-ui);font-weight:500;line-height:var(--line-ui);cursor:pointer;padding:8px 18px;border:1px solid var(--ui-glass-edge);border-radius:999px;color:var(--status-button-text);background:var(--crimson-danger);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 20%),0 4px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--crimson-danger) 18%,transparent)}.ds-danger:hover:not(:disabled){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--crimson-danger) 92%,var(--ui-ink))}.ds-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ui-blue);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-danger:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-danger:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5;box-shadow:none}

components.name: Paired navigation state

components.name: Schedule count

components.name: Settings section

components.name: Confirmation surface
components.description: Appearance preview only. Application use requires ConfirmationProvider/useConfirm for focus, cancellation and queue behavior.
components.html: Continue with this action?
components.css: .ds-confirm{display:grid;gap:24px;max-width:440px;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--ui-glass-edge);border-radius:26px;color:var(--ui-ink);background:var(--ui-glass-strong);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--ui-glass-highlight),0 24px 64px var(--ui-glass-shadow);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(120%);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(120%);font-family:var(--font-sans)}.ds-confirm h2{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:28px}.ds-confirm-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px}.ds-confirm-actions button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:var(--font-ui);font-weight:500;line-height:var(--line-ui);cursor:pointer;padding:8px 18px;border:1px solid var(--ui-glass-edge);border-radius:999px}.ds-confirm-cancel{color:var(--ui-ink);background:var(--ui-glass);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--ui-glass-highlight)}.ds-confirm-cancel:hover{background:var(--ui-glass-strong)}.ds-confirm-accept{color:var(--ui-on-blue);background:var(--ui-blue);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 24%),0 4px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-blue) 18%,transparent)}.ds-confirm-accept:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-blue) 92%,var(--ui-ink))}.ds-confirm-actions button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ui-blue);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-confirm-actions button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-confirm{gap:20px;padding:20px;border-radius:22px}}@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){.ds-confirm{-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;background:var(--surface-solid)}}

narrative.northStar: A quiet local-agent workspace in pale frosted glass.
narrative.overview:
The user-supplied Iconly component reference accepted on 2026-10-19 establishes the material, action shapes and paired icon states. That treatment now extends from the homepage across the existing workbench: settings, schedules, mail, notifications, task search, document selection, device menus, account menus and confirmations. It is one visual system, with the existing routes, content, capabilities, layouts and workflows retained.

This is an operator interface. Reading, composing and understanding actual state take priority over material effects. The homepage keeps its accepted geometry; secondary pages retain their established information structure and density.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray ground, milky translucent surfaces, bright inner edges and soft depth.
Blue primary actions; authored line and solid glyphs tied to real UI state.
Stable layouts and accessible interactions across themes and text preferences.

rules.name: The Surface Frost Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs on the visible sidebar, card or floating surface itself. Keep workspace, header and overlay ancestors unfiltered so fixed notifications and dialogs keep their viewport positioning. Native dialog backdrops may use their existing light blur.

rules.name: The Real State Rule
rules.body: Resting and hover states keep the line glyph. Real open, selected, current or pressed state shows the solid glyph and the more opaque selected surface. Closing a menu or panel restores its line trigger. One-shot actions may show the solid glyph during an enabled press. Disabled buttons do not gain a pressed state.

dos: **Do** extend the shared material through `--ui-*` while retaining homepage geometry and `--home-*` rules.
**Do** preserve all existing routes, menus, controls, business behavior and API boundaries.
**Do** verify original interactions alongside new styling in light, dark, large-text and reduced-preference modes.
**Do** show failure or recovery guidance when the user needs to act, and keep temporarily unavailable entry points with disabled operations.
donts: **Don't** replace existing screens with simplified pages or remove entry points to make the styling easier.
**Don't** blur workspace or header ancestors, clip floating menus, or make body portals depend on homepage-only tokens.
**Don't** change the Spark X wordmark, graphic mark, icon state semantics or confirmation focus behavior.
**Don't** add artificial connection states, placeholder data, permanent technical status UI or decorative animation.
